question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, empty capabilities, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), then a tools/list with no session header; Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, MCP-Protocol-Version 2025-06-18

headers.x-vercel-cache: MISS, and an x-vercel-id is present, so the server runs on Vercel behind Cloudflare
headers.mcp-session-id: absent: the server issues no session id, which is why a sessionless tools/list is answered

The server identifies itself by its platform, Fern, and not by the vendor whose documentation it serves
decoded.tools-list: 200, 677 bytes, exactly ONE tool: searchDocs, described as "Search the documentation at https://learning.postman.com. decoded.ownership-proof: /.well-known/public-agents.json answers 404 on learning.postman.com (14,730 bytes of the docs 404 page) and on www.postman.com (229,124 bytes of the marketing 404 page), the apex answers 301, and DNS TXT _public-agents.postman.com is NXDOMAIN (Status 3). The entry is unverified
decoded.sibling-endpoint: the vendor's other hosted MCP endpoint, https://mcp.postman.com/mcp, is a different product and not this entry's surface; the same keyless initialize there answers 401 with {"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32600,"message":"Invalid Request: API key required"},"id":null} (97 bytes, sha256 e1dad51f4f3c27c094d63ac085eb03a476e93b73fc496a6fb3a5c23817c968a7, re-read keyless 2026-10-22 at 12:03:10.714Z at the same bytes and digest) and a Bearer-scheme challenge naming its own protected-resource document, which answers 200 at 239 bytes and lists mcp.postman.com itself as its only authorization server

finding: The documentation MCP server named in Postman's own llms.txt answers a stranger. With no credential on 2026-10-21 at 06:28:49.100Z an MCP initialize answered 200 with 198 bytes, serverInfo fern-docs-mcp-server 1.0.0, and 0.46 seconds later a tools/list with no session header (the server issues none) answered 200 with exactly one tool: searchDocs, readOnlyHint true, topK capped at 20. Nothing carried a www-authenticate header and nothing asked for an account, so noAccountNeeded true and auth none are what this measures. The vendor's other hosted endpoint, mcp.postman.com, refuses the same request with 401 and names an API key, so the two should not be read as one surface. The registry ownership file is absent on both readable hosts and the DNS name is NXDOMAIN. One IP is one sample.
